name: Wall Slide
instructions: Stand with your back, head and forearms against a wall, with your elbows bent at 90 degrees at shoulder height.
Slide your arms up the wall until they are overhead, keeping your forearms and wrists in contact.
Slide them back down to the start.
Keep your lower back from arching away from the wall.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with the back, head and hips against a wall, both arms raised in a goalpost shape with the upper arms level with the shoulders, elbows bent at 90 degrees and forearms and backs of the hands flat on the wall, in an empty gym with no one else visible.
